findings.problem: A finite but absurd exchange rate (typed or restored, e.g. 1e300) made convert() round Infinity and throw on every build of the trips list.
findings.fix: Rates above 1e9 are rejected by parseRate and Backup.decode; convert returns 0 for a non-finite value.

findings.problem: splitPercent multiplied in 64-bit ints and could wrap for amounts near a trillion units in 3-decimal currencies.
Deleting a trip, payment or category had no error handling for a failed write.
findings.fix: try/catch with a snackbar in all three places.

findings.problem: A failed write while counting or granting a rewarded Pass could leave the button spinning or drop the reward without notice.
findings.fix: Errors are caught, the spinner always resets, and the Pass is kept in memory and scheduled even if the write fails.
